summary.name: QuickWrite
summary.one_liner: QuickWrite is a cloud-based, browser-accessed AI writing assistant aimed at fiction authors, covering brainstorming, world-building, character creation, book titles, marketing copy, and blogging.
use_cases: Overcoming writer's block with plot and writing prompts
Creating characters with backstories and traits
Generating book titles and descriptions or blurbs
Writing author newsletter emails and social posts
Finding names for characters, places, and items
summary.what_it_does: QuickWrite is a cloud-based tool accessed through a web browser, aimed at fiction authors. The page lists fiction features such as plot suggestions, character descriptions and backstories, world-building help, unique name creation, book titles, book descriptions, and writing prompts. It also offers marketing and business tools like emails, taglines, sales copy, and social media posts, plus blogging tools such as article ideas, outlines, and meta descriptions. The page also lists non-fiction features, including book outlines and chapter outlines. It says content is generated from analysis of a user's writing style and intent, but gives no technical detail about the underlying models.
notable: Fiction-focused toolset covering plot, characters, names, titles, and book blurbs
Marketing and blogging tools for authors, including email, social posts, and podcast templates
Positioned as a beta launch with a one-time fee offer and no word or credit limits for early users
caveats: Early-adopter offer is described as a one-time fee, but the page says future customers will pay monthly or yearly fees; the price itself is not stated
Account is limited to one user and sharing logins is prohibited
The page says the offer applies only if you sign up before the launch period ends
